Shelter dog day-out programs in the U.S.: November 2026 report

⁠⁢‍‌⁢⁢​​‌‌​‌⁢‍‍⁢⁢⁠How many animal shelters let the public take a dog out for the day, a hike or a sleepover? Here are the exact counts from our national directory, refreshed every month.

Key numbers

  • 4,106 animal shelters, humane societies and SPCAs listed
  • 713 day-out, field trip, sleepover or hiking programs found (17.36% of shelters listed)
  • Programs found in 51 of 51 jurisdictions (the 50 states plus D.C.)
  • 195 programs that include cats

Programs by status

  • 411 open to public
  • 153 volunteers only
  • 143 needs check
  • 6 paused

"Needs check" means we found a program but couldn't confirm it's still running on the shelter's website this month.

Programs by type

  • 527 day trips and outings (73.91% of programs)
  • 242 sleepovers and short-term fosters (33.94% of programs)
  • 70 hikes, walks and runs (9.82% of programs)
  • 98 visits, lounges and cafés (13.74% of programs)

Many programs offer more than one kind of outing, so these add up to more than the total.

How we count

We build the directory from shelters' own websites and public government pages, and re-check listings every month. A shelter counts as having a program when its own site describes a day-out, field trip, sleepover, hiking or similar outing program. Shelters we haven't found a program for are still listed, and visitors can ask them to start one. New this month? See new programs.

Using this data

You're welcome to quote these figures in articles and research. Please credit "ShelterDayOut (Charity Good)" with a link to this page. The CSV is provided for citing these state totals; copying or republishing the directory itself isn't allowed (see our Terms). Press questions: hello@shelterdayout.com.
